<function=python>
<parameter=code>
# Check which targets are still present (charcoal squares)
seg = current_frame.segmentation
nodes = seg['nodes']

# Find charcoal squares (targets)
charcoal_targets = []
for node in nodes:
    if node['color'] == 'c' and node['pixels'] == 8:
        boundary = node['boundary']
        rows = [p[0] for p in boundary]
        cols = [p[1] for p in boundary]
        center_r = sum(rows) / len(rows)
        center_c = sum(cols) / len(cols)
        charcoal_targets.append((center_r, center_c))

print(f"Charcoal targets remaining: {len(charcoal_targets)}")
for t in sorted(charcoal_targets):
    print(f"  ~({t[0]:.0f}, {t[1]:.0f})")

# Check original target positions
original_targets = [(6, 6), (6, 45), (15, 51), (21, 21), (27, 9), (30, 48), (33, 33), (39, 21)]
print(f"\nOriginal targets: {original_targets}")

# Check which original targets are still present
remaining = []
for ot in original_targets:
    found = False
    for ct in charcoal_targets:
        if abs(ct[0] - ot[0]) < 2 and abs(ct[1] - ot[1]) < 2:
            found = True
            break
    if found:
        remaining.append(ot)
    else:
        print(f"  Target {ot} COLLECTED!")

print(f"\nRemaining targets: {remaining}")

# Try deselecting the diamond to see if targets are collected
result = action(['SPACE'])
print(f"\nAfter SPACE: level_completed={result.get('level_completed')}, done={result.get('done')}")
